summary: A feedstock lot arrives within every specification on the certificate and carries a contaminant at a concentration no party had characterised, from a process change two tiers up the supply chain that had not occurred before.

signal_basis.prior_report: searched incoming-material correspondence and the supplier file: nothing
signal_basis.figure_without_clock: searched: the certificate figures carry their method and their date
signal_basis.designed_control: searched: no control was proposed, because the species had not been named anywhere
signal_basis.no_instrument: the incoming assay covers the specified species and is fit for that purpose. This one is a gap in CHARACTERISATION, not in the instrument's constitution -- a different reading, argued in the authoring note
signal_basis.held_data_unasked: searched the supplier file and the incoming-assay archive: the species is not present in any held data, which is what makes this the negative rather than HELD_BUT_UNASKED

remedy.text: add a non-targeted screen to incoming assay

authoring_note: The reachable negative, and the hardest case to author honestly. It is built ABSENT on all four signals so it lands on NOT_FORESEEN rather than NOT_DERIVABLE. The contestable call is no_instrument: one reading is that an assay covering only specified species IS a constitutional exclusion, which would make this GAP_UNINSTRUMENTED. Recorded rather than resolved -- and the remedy is deliberately left aimed at GAP_UNINSTRUMENTED, so route-to-remedy reports a mismatch that is really a disagreement about the bin.
